name: dense
description: A Claude Code plugin that folds everything per turn.

foldFailedTurns.title: Fold turns with a failed tool call
foldFailedTurns.description: On: such a turn folds too, its summary line saying how many calls failed. Off: it stays expanded.

hideNotes.title: Hide the text between tool calls
hideNotes.description: On: only the final answer of a folded turn stays. Off: only tool calls fold.
